trigger-model-batched.detail: This connection is set to issue in batches, and batched issuing is not available yet, so nothing was issued. Issue it by hand, or switch the connection to issue on payment.

clear.effectiveWindow: This rule cannot match the same order as {rule} - their effective periods never coincide.
clear.generic: This rule cannot match the same order as {rule}.
clear.orderCountry: This rule cannot match the same order as {rule} - they are scoped to different delivery countries.

undecided.unreadableCondition: We could not tell whether this rule collides with {rule} - it carries a condition this version does not understand. Open it and check what it says.

ambiguous-connection-no-primary.detail: More than one setup could issue this document and nothing chooses between them: either this country has both an invoice default and a receipt default, or several providers can issue and none is marked to go first. Keep one of them, or add a rule that decides.

conflicting-rules-equal-priority.detail: Two or more rules matched this order. Rules have no order of priority, so nothing picks a winner and the order is held. Narrow the conditions until only one rule can match.

net-priced-order.detail: A rule compares the order total, but this order is priced net. The comparison cannot be made, so the order is held.

no-configuration-for-country.detail: Neither this country nor Rest of world has a rule or a default. Nothing is issued here, and nothing will be until you set routing.

no-connection-declares-document-kind.detail: This system can issue documents, but no connection says which kind it should issue. Pick one in Settings, Sales documents routing, and orders start getting invoices.

no-matching-rule.detail: No rule here matched this order, and there is no single default to fall back on. The order is held. It does not pass to Rest of world.

routed-connection-unavailable.detail: Your routing sends this order to a connection that is turned off, has been removed, or can no longer issue this document, so nothing was issued. Turn that connection back on, or point the rule at another connection.

threshold-currency-mismatch.detail: A rule sets its limit in a different currency from this order. Amounts are never converted when routing decides, so the order is held.

unsupported-document-kind-on-connection.detail: Routing picked a document this provider cannot issue. Choose a provider that issues this kind.
